reasons.intelligence: Goal is precise (one coordinate per 449 Location_ids with source/confidence); the core assumption is explicitly checked — OSM-to-anonymous-ID mapping is declared an 'unbewiesene Heuristik' capped at confidence=low, and drift is fenced off via named non-goals (no 1:1 claims, no GIS bloat, no routing/dashboard expansion) plus scope-creep freeze times.
reasons.feasibility: Boundaries are a tight path whitelist; upstream-first is satisfied with ≥3 reuse candidates mandated in UPSTREAM_SEARCH.md plus live Overpass/open-data verification; DoD is measurable (exactly 449 rows, ID-set equality, uniqueness, WGS84 ranges, required columns, mocked timeout/HTTP/schema tests, working import).
reasons.ease: Slice is coherent and resume works through deterministic file artifacts (seed 2026, canonical locations.csv, swap via drop-in real CSV), but it bundles fetcher, resolver, refresh script, sanity HTML, two docs and full unit+E2E tests into one slice — splitting fetch from resolver would be smaller.
reasons.efficiency: Budget is bounded (single documented BBox query, 10s/30s timeouts, max one retry, stdlib HTTP, no new dependencies, no config changes) and write fanout is constrained by the explicit whitelist plus data/external/ and Projek-Managment/ only — no explosion.
